contract: FNV-1a fingerprints remain byte-for-byte compatible. ASCII prefix hashing uses two unsigned 32-bit words and exact carry arithmetic for the prime 2^40 + 435. After the first non-ASCII code unit, the established TextEncoder-compatible UTF8/BigInt loop continues from the exact intermediate digest. No encoded copy or input-sized workspace is introduced; behavior selects itself from content.
rejectedExperiments: Captured two-word state was substantially slower than the published BigInt loop.
Register-local two-word arithmetic improved ASCII but regressed general Unicode; it is not shipped.
validationCases: Every UTF16 code unit and surrogate boundary against independent TextEncoder/BigInt reference
Deterministic mixed UTF16 sequences through 65536 units
ASCII-to-Unicode transitions at 0/1/31/1024/65536 units, including NUL, DEL and lone surrogate
Existing exact/one-byte-short fingerprint serialization admission and zero cleanup
remaining: Broader allocation integration and whole-runtime caps

performance.node: Final sum of per-case medians 0.85435 → 0.67522 ms; workload mix is diagnostic, not a real query. Large ASCII improved around 1.5–1.7x across runs; Unicode/mixed results vary around parity.
performance.worker: Native workerd host-timed comparison: about 1.20x for 1024-character ASCII, 1.00x for 65536-character ASCII. Unicode/mixed cases range around parity; dispatch overhead is included.
performance.completeQueries: Metadata-enabled real Parquet comparisons: 309.61 → 308.08 ms and 296.89 → 300.15 ms. Both check all 512 rows, metadata/decoded warm hits, zero warm requests and zero final charges. No end-to-end speedup claim.

validation.releaseChecks: build, types, package consumers, compatibility, changeset, fixtures, large files, lint passed

arithmeticProof: For H = high*2^32 + low and P = 2^40 + 435, low*435 is below 2^41 and exactly representable. Its upper word is the carry; the new high word is high*435 + carry + low*256 modulo 2^32. Math.imul and bitwise truncation implement those modular terms, while division by 2^32 gives an exact carry before floor. UTF8 continuation starts from the reconstructed 64-bit digest.
